verdict.rationale: Brex's own materials claim AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments, and list bill pay as part of the platform. The Payments API manages vendors and sends ACH, wires, and checks, and the MCP server can track bills, so all three elements (bill intake, approval, vendor payment) are claimed first-party. missing for 10: detailed docs on bill upload methods and approval routing (multi-step approvers, rules, thresholds), independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill approval workflow.
